scope: PrepForge backend (src/prepforge_chess + its API contracts). Objective navigation index; no findings.

stack.orm: SQLAlchemy (Core tables in storage/sa_tables.py; ORM identity models in api/models.py; shared engine api/db.py)
stack.schema_authority: Alembic (migrations/); storage/database.py is ephemeral SQLite for CLI/tests only (guarded by tests/test_sa_tables.py)
stack.db: SQLite (dev/test, WAL, per-connection PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON) / PostgreSQL (prod, pool_size=10 max_overflow=20)
stack.engines: Stockfish WASM + Maia3 ONNX run in the browser; server build/train/match paths run no engine

areas.title: Training / Scheduler
entrypoints: SmartTrainingService.start_or_resume / start_or_resume_mixed / current_prompt / session_card_bundle / submit_move / skip_card / sync_progress / counts
call_chains: POST /api/train/smart/start -> SmartTrainingService.start_or_resume[_mixed] -> scheduler.build_session_plan (repertoire tree + training_progress) -> repository.save_training_session (cards into training_sessions.line_order) -> current_prompt + session_card_bundle -> router _smart_summary_payload (health bookend)
POST /api/train/smart/move -> SmartTrainingService.submit_move -> training.record_attempt -> repository.save_training_progress + save_training_session (SR written only when attempt == 1)
POST /api/train/smart/sync -> SmartTrainingService.sync_progress -> repository.record_attempt_receipt + training_progress + training_sessions upsert in ONE transaction per attempt
cross_module: training_smart -> scheduler (card codec), training.record_attempt/update_spaced_repetition, repositories (incl. private _upsert helpers for single-transaction writes)
routers/train.py -> routers/workspace._owned_repertoire (shared ownership gate), progress, streak, training_view
invariants: Grading contract: only attempt == 1 writes SR progress; retries and play-after-reveal never inflate accuracy (training_smart docstring)

Exactly-once sync keyed by (session_id, attempt_uuid): identical retry is a no-op, same UUID with different (node_id, correct) is a ValueError (409-class); receipt + SR + session commit in one transaction so streak advances only on new attempts
MAX_SYNC_ATTEMPTS = 500, MAX_SYNC_QUEUE = 500; malformed queue entries are dropped, not persisted
SR formula: correct -> score=min(10, score+1), due in round(score) days; wrong -> score*=0.5, due +10min; is_mastered = score>=7.0 and correct_attempts>=3
Cards stored in existing training_sessions.line_order as kind:first:last (mixed: kind:repertoire_id:first:last); decode_card accepts both encodings; root->last_target path is unique in the tree
Scheduler constants: DEFAULT_SESSION_SIZE=12, DEFAULT_NEW_CAP=4, DEFAULT_MAX_TARGETS_PER_CARD=3, WEAK_SHARE=0.6, RUN_IN_PLIES=3
SmartPrompt ships expected move + hint texts to the client on purpose (own repertoire, not a quiz)
Streak day = player's calendar date, clamped +/-1 day around UTC; advance is an atomic mutate_user_setting (no lost update vs recap snapshot)
training_sessions has no owner column: ownership resolves session -> repertoire -> owner (_owned_session)

areas.title: Repertoire matching
call_chains: GET|POST /api/lichess/compare -> _run_compare -> lichess_fetch.fetch_recent_pgns -> ChessCore.import_pgn_games -> match_game_against_repertoires (enabled children only) -> _build_summary (with expected_node_id) -> record_departure_misses -> JSON (each game tagged source_account)
cross_module: repertoire_matching is pure (core/models only, no DB)
invariants: departure_reason in {user_left_preparation, opponent_unprepared_branch, game_stayed_in_preparation, no_repertoire_for_color}
Only user_left_preparation records a recall miss (opponent novelties are not misses); expected_node_id is the move the user should have played; miss lands due_at = last_reviewed_at (next session)
Idempotent per game via lichess.departure_misses_ingested (capped 300); recorded summaries set training_recorded=true
Matching walks enabled children only; expected child = first is_mainline, else first enabled
Comparison is owner-scoped (only the caller's repertoires)

areas.title: Opening tree / persistence (Build)
entrypoints: OpeningBuilderService: create_repertoire / add_move / add_moves_batch / apply_generation_plan / set_as_mainline / mark_prepared / disable_branch / enable_branch / add_comment / add_tag / set_annotations / delete_node / delete_nodes_batch / rename_repertoire / set_repertoire_active / remove_repertoire / tree_report (generate_from_node is CLI-only)
workspace_view.build_workspace_payload (every Build mutation response funnels through it)
RepertoireExportService: export_package_json / export_mainline_pgn / export_node_path_pgn / import_package_json / import_tree_pgn
call_chains: POST /api/build/add-moves (local-first flush) -> add_moves_batch (all-or-nothing; returns id_map tempId->real) -> build_workspace_payload

Build-Generate: recursion runs in the BROWSER (Stockfish+Maia3); POST /api/build/generate/apply-plan -> apply_generation_plan (server re-validates legality/parentage, recomputes persisted flags, no compute) -> build_workspace_payload
POST /api/build/action -> dispatch per action to builder methods -> build_workspace_payload

write: repertoires (incl. health_json), opening_nodes, engine_evaluations, positions; delete_opening_nodes nulls training_sessions.current_node_id first

cross_module: opening_builder -> opening_generation (constants/protocols/merge), services/engine (EngineAdapter/MockEngine), services/maia (MaiaAdapter, CLI generate path), core/chess_core, repositories

routers/workspace.py -> workspace_view, opening_builder, repertoire_export, api/config.Settings (quota: free_repertoire_limit), routers.teams.user_team_ids (team share reads), dashboard_recommendations
invariants: Zero server engine compute on Build mutation paths: evals arrive from the browser (White-POV EngineEvaluation); server validates, recomputes flags, persists. generate_from_node (server-side generate) is CLI-only

Untrusted plan guards: plan sources restricted to GENERATED_STOCKFISH/GENERATED_MAIA3 (_PLAN_GENERATED_SOURCES, cannot forge MANUAL/IMPORTED_PGN authorship); MAX_PLAN_CHANGES=2000, MAX_PLAN_DEPTH=64, MAX_PLAN_PV_LENGTH=64; MAX_ADD_MOVES_BATCH=500, MAX_DELETE_NODES_BATCH=200, MAX_BULK_MOVES=500, MAX_BULK_DELETE_NODES=200
Persisted flags: own-move (repertoire.color to move) = is_user_prepared_move; first enabled child of a parent = is_mainline
Tree persistence: opening_nodes stores arriving UCI + parent; FEN reconstructed by walking from repertoires.root_fen; update_opening_nodes writes diffs only (_changed_nodes snapshot)

Import de-identifies: package import always _reassign_ids (fresh ids = importer's own copy, no cross-tenant clobber); _enforce_repertoire_quota (free_repertoire_limit, 402) on every repertoire-producing route
Read-only shares strip personal data: _strip_readonly_build_payload removes health/summary/per-node mastery from share-link and team read views
Package contract: PACKAGE_KIND='prepforge_repertoire_package', PACKAGE_SCHEMA_VERSION=1; id/tag/name/comment validated (_ID_PATTERN, _TAG_PATTERN, _NAME_MAX=200, _COMMENT_MAX=2000)
delete_opening_nodes clears training_sessions.current_node_id references before deleting (FK safety)

areas.title: Games attribution
areas.summary: How a game row is attributed to an owner / linked account / source, including dedup and claiming rules.
entrypoints: PrepForgeRepository.claim_or_verify_game / claim_repertoire / find_game_id_by_lichess_id / save_game / save_game_batched / load_game / list_games
call_chains: Paste/import: POST /api/analyze/prepare (_import_pgn_for_analysis) or Lichess import -> PgnImportService.import_text -> dedup (lichess_id -> move-signature) -> repository.save_game(game, owner_user_id=owner)

Watcher: GET /api/lichess/latest -> _links_for (primary first) -> newest_game_across (bounded concurrency, dedup by game id, newest by finish time) -> payload with source_account; POST /api/lichess/seen writes lichess.last_seen_game_id

write: games (upsert; owner_user_id coalesce-fill, lichess_id, source), moves/positions/engine_evaluations (save_game rebuild or save_game_batched bulk), linked_accounts (link/unlink/set-primary), user_settings

cross_module: routers/lichess.py -> api/security.encrypt_token (OAuth token at rest), lichess_fetch
invariants: Owner is fill-only: save_game upsert uses coalesce_cols=('owner_user_id',) — a re-save never reassigns; claim_* only fill NULL (first writer wins). claim_or_verify_game returns False (treated as not-found) when the game is missing or owned by another user
Owner-scoped dedup: duplicate lookups (lichess_id / move-signature) only scan the caller's own games — two users importing the same game keep independent rows
Signature dedup: signature = ' '.join(move.uci); in-batch duplicates are skipped and the EXISTING id is reported (for re-analysis)

LinkedAccount.is_primary: exactly one primary per provider (_demote_others) is the default source for My-last-game / compare / explorer; backfill migration must use typed Boolean updates (tests/test_migration_lichess_primary.py)

source_account attribution: compare/latest tag each game with its source linked username; compare_many_identities splits the count budget (_COMPARE_COUNT_MAX = 50) with bounded concurrency, dedups by game id, and degrades partially on per-account failure
External usernames: compare accepts arbitrary public Lichess usernames (shared Source Composer), but matching stays owner-scoped
is_new compares newest game id to user_settings lichess.last_seen_game_id, updated only by POST /api/lichess/seen

areas.title: Scout backend contracts
areas.summary: Scout (opponent scouting) runs in the browser; the backend provides data sources and boundary contracts only.
entrypoints: web-src/scout.js: fetcher (injected deps), trie/triePathKey, scoutFetchErrorMessage; MAX_PLIES=16, ANALYZE_PLIES=24
web-src/scout-engine.js: opt-in Stockfish deep scan (SCOUT_ENGINE_DEPTH=12, localStorage cache schema v3)
web-src/scout-maia.js / scout-maia-harness.js: Maia3 ONNX in browser worker
contracts: Direct Lichess public API from the browser (no backend fetch): scout.js fetches public PGN exports. CSP contract: middleware._LICHESS_API_HOSTS puts https://lichess.org in connect-src (AUTO Maia rating also reads the public profile)

Explorer proxy: GET /api/lichess/explorer/{db_name} (masters | player pool). Server pins query params (not a general proxy), requires a linked token, in-process LRU cache (TTL 24h, cap 500), upstream 429 -> 429 pass-through, route limit 120/min. Client cache in web-src/explorer.js: localStorage prepforge.explorer.cache.v1, TTL 1 week, cap 150, 60s cooldown on 429
Shared Source Composer: Games + Scout share source selection (localStorage prepforge.scout_self / scout_source / scout_external), resolved into usernames/account_ids for GET|POST /api/lichess/compare
Repertoire data for grading prep against opponent lines comes from workspace endpoints (/api/repertoires, /api/build/load)

Boundary: tests/test_scout_production_boundary.py forbids 'from research' / 'import research' / 'research/module_b' / 'scripts/run_' in src/ and web-src/; research runners (scripts/scout-*.mjs, research/scout-*) are not product runtime

write: (browser) localStorage: scout engine cache prepforge.scout.engine.v3:* (v1/v2 stale prefixes cleaned), explorer cache, source selection keys

invariants: Scout never fetches opponent games through the server and never runs number-crunching there (web-src/scout.js header)
Tokenless direct fetches need no proxy (middleware comment); any tokened upstream goes through the server proxy (explorer)
All scout caches are schema-versioned (engine cache v3 with stale-prefix cleanup; explorer cache v1)
Product code must not import research Module B runners (enforced by test)

areas.title: Database mutation / caching / invalidation
entrypoints: save_game vs save_game_batched (per-move rebuild vs single-transaction bulk)
codec: game_uci_blob / move_needs_row / position_key / encode_search_limit (UNSET_SEARCH_LIMIT) / encode_pv / encode_wdl

caches.name: repertoires.health_json
caches.write: build_workspace_payload (every Build mutation; IS DISTINCT FROM skip) + train._smart_summary_payload (smart bookends)

caches.name: scout engine scan cache
caches.invalidation: schema v3 keys; stale v1/v2 prefixes purged

invariants: Alembic is the sole production schema lifecycle: no runtime create_all patching, no schema.sql fixture (tests/test_sa_tables.py drift guard)
user_settings is one fact per row (streak, recap, lichess markers, prefs); cross-key concurrent writes never clobber; same-key RMW goes through mutate_user_setting
Ownership columns are fill-only (coalesce_cols / claim_*); never reassigned
FK safety: SQLite re-asserts PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON per connection; delete_opening_nodes nulls training_sessions.current_node_id first

Compact codec contract: disk truth = initial_fen + uci_blob (moves rows only for non-rebuildable annotations via move_needs_row); positions are full 6-field FEN (unique); eval key = (position_id, engine, depth, nodes, time_ms) with UNSET_SEARCH_LIMIT for unset limits (NULL-safe UNIQUE); opening nodes = (parent, uci) with FEN walked from root_fen; SAN/FEN/PGN derived on read
Datetime persistence: domain tables store ISO-8601 TEXT; dashboard due queries compare LEXICALLY (due_at <= now_iso) — the format is load-bearing (tests/test_storage_datetime_persistence.py)
